title: Trav Privacy Policy
body:
Effective 20 October 2026. Trav is a travel discovery and AI planning app developed by Jaydeo Sawale. Contact: jaydeep.sawale97@gmail.com.

Information we use

If you create an account, we store your name, email address and a password hash, together with authentication and recovery records. Signed-in features store your travel preferences, destination searches and interactions, saved places, trips, budgets, dates, planning conversations and generated itineraries. Do not enter payment credentials, passport numbers or other sensitive information in AI prompts.

Optional location

Nearby can request your approximate or precise foreground location when you choose to use your current location. Coordinates are sent to our API and location discovery providers to find nearby places. You can decline permission and choose a place instead. Trav does not request background location.

AI, maps and service providers

Planning prompts, relevant trip preferences and recent conversation context may be processed by Google Gemini or Groq, depending on the configured provider. Google’s unpaid Gemini service may use submitted content and generated responses to improve its products and machine learning models; human reviewers may process that content. Do not submit personal, sensitive or confidential information. AI answers can be incorrect: independently verify travel conditions, opening hours, prices and safety advice. Place discovery and maps use services including OpenStreetMap/Overpass, Geoapify, Wikidata, Wikipedia and Wikimedia. External map tiles, photos and links may disclose your IP address and requested place to those providers. Booking links open external websites; their privacy policies apply.

The application is hosted using Render, Neon PostgreSQL and Vercel. Our servers and hosting providers process technical request information, such as IP addresses, request times, error information and browser or device information, to operate and secure the service. Trav does not sell personal data or contain advertising.

Content reports

When you report AI content in the app, we store your account identifier, reason, optional details and a bounded copy of the reported answer or itinerary for developer review and safety improvements. Please do not include sensitive information in report details.

Security and retention

Network connections to our API use HTTPS. Passwords are hashed, and authentication tokens on Android use secure storage. No service can guarantee absolute security. Account and travel records remain until deleted or no longer needed to provide the service. AI drafts may expire; temporary discovery caches and operational logs have separate operational retention. Provider backup copies may remain temporarily until their normal rotation.

Your choices and deletion

You can decline location permission, remove saved items and request deletion of your account and associated personal data. See Delete account and data. You can contact us to request access or correction. We may ask you to confirm ownership before acting.

Audience and updates

Trav is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Contact us if you believe a child has provided personal information. We may update this policy; the effective date above identifies the current version.

title: Trav — Delete Account and Data
body:
Trav is developed by Jaydeo Sawale. You can request deletion without installing or signing in to the app.

How to request deletion

  1. Email jaydeep.sawale97@gmail.com with the subject “Trav account deletion”.
  2. Send the request from your registered email address and state that you want your Trav account and associated data deleted. Never send your password.
  3. We will confirm account ownership if necessary, process your request and reply when complete. Requests are normally completed within 30 days.

In the app, open Profile → Delete account and data to reach these instructions. To request removal of specific data while keeping your account, identify the trips, saved places or conversations in your email.

What is removed

Deletion removes your account, authentication and recovery records, stored travel preferences, personal search and place interaction history, saved places, trips and itinerary records, AI conversations and drafts, and content reports linked to your account. Public place catalogue information is not personal account data and is retained.

Limited retention

Operational backups may retain copies temporarily until normal backup rotation. Records that must be kept to meet legal obligations or investigate abuse may be retained only as necessary for that purpose. Third-party services control their own logs and retention. We will explain any exception that applies to your request.

Read the Trav privacy policy.
